focus_area_title: Learn How to Overcome Common Obstacles
content_text_body:
The goal is for each team member to learn what to do when obstacles emerge that prevent successful teamwork.

### Interdependencies

Teams not only work with each other, they often also work with other teams. Other team members or entire teams can slow down or impede your team from reaching your goals. Building strong communication skills within and across teams can help the team overcome these obstacles. Consider these options:

Talk to your manager or team leader 1 on 1 about issues you are having.

Reach out to other teams, leaders, or individuals and ask for specific dates that you should expect deliverables. 

### Keep the lines of communication open

Try to maintain the lines of communication even when there are no obstacles with progress updates and regular reminders. This will make it easier to bring up issues when and if they occur.
